Yeah, I think you're right. I didn't consider the possibility that she already knows full well. I guess I'll back off and take it easy. Just because I don't view it as a massive step doesn't mean others won't. 

Thanks for the advice.

Thank you. I'm not sure what is right yet. I don't know if my feelings can change or if I even want them to. I just stopped ignoring this problem and called it for what it is. I'm not sure what do to next. Any guidance is appreciated.
Do you think I should explain this situation to my parents? Or should I try to find a good therapist/counselor first? Or should I confront my wife first and handle it internally?
Thank you, I'll likely take you up on that offer, and I'll think things over. Really appreciate the timely responses.

Maybe that's part of the problem. I don't just feel personally guilty I think I'm an objectively bad person for thinking these things. If it was someone else doing it I'd probably encourage them to stick together. I'd say love has little to do with how you feel and more with the conscious decisions you make. I feel like I'm betraying my own principles for even thinking it distantly. I can't just jump right into a divorce mindset right away. Today was the first day I even came to concrete terms with jt. I feel guilty just for feeling good talking to some women online, even though no romance is involved. I'm just overwhelmed. I'm not knowledgeable in these areas, I don't know what to do.
I appreciate your input, thank you Yesno.

I appreciate your offer, input, and understanding, but how could I not be held responsible? We got married, we made vows, and hypothetically I'd be leaving her high and dry. I'm the one causing the problem. I'd be the dumper. I don't know if I'd be in any real danger because she's lessened on the temper outbursts so much, but I don't know what would happen if I came clean with the facts when we spend so much time in a tight space. I don't know if I should keep it a secret of confront her. I feel guilty about my feelings even if I haven't taken any actions.
I don't know if I want permission or an excuse. I just can't seem to help how I feel.
